footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted pursuant to the Issuer's 2026 Equity Incentive Plan (the "Plan"). The RSUs will vest in three equal annual installments beginning on November 10, 2027, subject to the Continuous Service (as defined in the Plan) of the Reporting Person as of each applicable vesting date.  The RSUs have no expiration date. This grant was made pursuant to the Issuer's non-employee director compensation policy. || Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of voting common stock of the Issuer.
